metadata.title: Corruption Semantic Patterns
metadata.description: Versioned semantic patterns for corruption, bribery, influence peddling, and related reviewer reasoning.

concepts.title: Corruption
concepts.description: Abuse of power for private gain.

concepts.title: Bribery
concepts.description: Offering, giving, requesting, or accepting an improper benefit.

concepts.title: Influence Peddling
concepts.description: Trading on influence or connections for an improper benefit.

concepts.title: Favor Exchange
concepts.description: A benefit or service exchanged for improper advantage.

concepts.title: Payment
concepts.description: Money or valuable consideration used in the exchange.

concepts.title: Contract Abuse
concepts.description: Manipulating a contract or procurement process unfairly.

concepts.title: Abuse of Power
concepts.description: Using authority or position to secure an improper outcome.

entries.title: Bribery Exchange
entries.description: Patterns where a payment, gift, or favor is exchanged for a permit, approval, or other official action.
supporting_evidence: A cash object, envelope, or gift is mentioned near a request for approval.
A permit, license, or signature appears in the same exchange.
contradictory_evidence: The speaker explicitly rejects the offer.
The scene is clearly a warning, investigation, or condemnation.
false_positives: A genuine gift between family members.
A lawful payment with no official favor requested.
counter_examples: A legal invoice with no hidden request.
cross_sentence_indicators: A polite sentence is followed by a request for approval.
A gift is mentioned before an official decision.
reviewer_guidance: Check whether the payment or favor is tied to an official act.
Do not classify ordinary payments as bribery without the corrupt link.

confidence_modifiers.title: Investigation Context
confidence_modifiers.description: Context that reduces confidence because the scene is evidentiary.

glossary_relationships.note: Bribery is a core corruption signal.
Payment is often the visible vehicle for bribery.

gcam_mappings.note: Use when corruption harms public interest or official integrity.
Use when corruption is embedded in deceptive factual presentation.
Use when corruption is tied to financial misconduct.

examples.title: Envelope exchange
examples.expected_outcome: Possible bribery because payment and official action appear together.

examples.title: Favor phrase
examples.expected_outcome: Bribery is suggested by an improper favor exchange.

entries.title: Influence Peddling
entries.description: Patterns where a connection, status, or influence is traded for preferential treatment.
supporting_evidence: A character claims access to a decision maker or official.
A request for special treatment follows the claim of influence.
contradictory_evidence: The scene shows a normal referral with no improper benefit.
The speaker is joking and the story clearly treats it as a joke.
false_positives: A legitimate reference from one professional to another.
A family member asking for lawful help.
counter_examples: A legal referral to customer support.
cross_sentence_indicators: Connection mentioned before a favor request.
A later sentence confirms a special shortcut.
reviewer_guidance: Look for the link between influence and benefit.
Separate legitimate help from improper advantage.
Use scene-level context to judge whether influence is being sold.

confidence_modifiers.title: Named Connection
confidence_modifiers.description: A specific authority or insider is named.

confidence_modifiers.title: Unspecified Hint
confidence_modifiers.description: Only a vague suggestion of influence exists.

confidence_modifiers.title: Explicit Rejection
confidence_modifiers.description: The scene rejects or undermines the improper influence.

glossary_relationships.note: Influence peddling commonly sits inside corruption reasoning.
Using influence for advantage is a form of power abuse.

gcam_mappings.note: Use when influence peddling undermines public trust or fairness.
Use when influence peddling affects a business or contract outcome.

examples.title: Inside connection
examples.text: عندي ناس تمشيها، بس نحتاج نسمع كلمة منك.
examples.expected_outcome: Possible influence peddling because a connection is traded for a favor.

examples.title: Special access
examples.text: أنا أعرفه شخصيًا، وراح يسويها لنا.
examples.expected_outcome: Potential influence peddling due to implied preferential treatment.
